description: Create a draft, or schedule a post or thread, on connected channels. Give channel_ids from list_channels and scheduled_at (ISO 8601 with Z or an offset) or schedule_in_minutes; omit both for a draft. Attach media with media_ids (list_media) or media_urls (public https links). channel_bodies gives particular channels their own text. Pass an idempotency_key so a retried call returns the first post instead of a duplicate. YouTube needs a video and youtube.made_for_kids. TikTok posts can only be saved as drafts (the user schedules them in Postbase). Check the outcome later with get_post.

body.description: The post text, for a single post.

channel_bodies.description: Text for particular channels instead of body, keyed by channel id, e.g. a shorter X version.

channel_ids.description: Channel ids to publish to (from list_channels).

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this post; a repeat with the same key returns the first post.

media_ids.description: Media library ids from list_media, in order.

media_urls.description: Public https links to images or a video, attached after media_ids and added to the media library (up to 10).

schedule_in_minutes.description: Publish this many minutes from now (server clock). Use for relative times.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 time with Z or an offset, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00+01:00. Omit for a draft.

thread.description: Several posts to publish as a thread, in order (instead of body).

youtube.description: YouTube details, when a YouTube channel is in channel_ids.

made_for_kids.description: Required to schedule to YouTube; ask the user.

name: create_post
